text: Yeezuu yɩrɛ bɩ zaa ba n nɩ: A da Maarii bɩ, nyɩnta a ʊ Zozɛf jaan, bɩ, an lɛɛ ka kʊ Maarii n a ba Zozɛf lʊ bɩ, *Sɛnt-Ɛspri a ka Maarii n jɩsɩ sa.
translated: Now this is how it all happened: The mother of Jesus, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, but before they came together, it was found that Mary was pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

ref: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
text: a nyɩ yɩm yar, k'ɩ tɔ ka Yeezuu, bala, a m n'a do bɩ bʊmbɔrɛ a mimbʊnyaarɔ nɔ ʊ.»
translated: If you have faith, go to Jesus, perhaps He will heal you from your sickness.

ref: and said, “Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.”
text: ŋnɩ laaka da: «Zɩɩfʊrɔ cir k'a yɩ b'ɩ ka? Wɔɔ monyaa yɩ dɔjɩr ʊ bɩ y'a ka, wɔɔ n bʊr k'ʊ b'a da ʊ.»
translated: The chief said: "Why are you here? If you have come for good, you are welcome, but if you have come for evil, you are not welcome."

ref: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
text: Hɩrɔɔdɩ k'a b'a dɔ a ʊ, hɔdonno wɔɔ a yamba a m bɩ, a wuti nɔmaa gandaara m. Amba hɔdonno wɔɔ a hɩ m, nyɩnta k'a ʊ, an laaka da k'a nyɩ bɩ yɩrɛ dɔmɩm dɔ bɩ ma.
translated: Herod wanted to kill the child, but God warned him in a dream, so he fled with his mother to Egypt. ref: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
text: N zeedarɛ ma Ramaa ʊ, nyikəre kan heerzarlɛ gʊta kɩ: Rasɛl nɩ nyi karɛ a nyɩnɔ minto, a lɛ baa kʊ n n'a wɔ zɩnzɛ a nɩ y, nyɩnɔ wɔɔ kʊ ŋ gɩnga bɩ tɔ ma. Zozɛf bɔ Eziptɩ ʊ
translated: And Joseph said to Rama, remember what I told you: If you see someone coming to you, do not be afraid because I am with you, I will go with you wherever you go. Joseph was in Egypt.

text: Yeezuu k'a batɛm bɩ si bɩ, a bɔ hi b'ʊ. A m bɩ, brama n a gʊ, an Woso Ɛspri yɩ an nɩ zerle, am cirpʊʊrɛ hɔ bɩ m an bɩ zer la.

translated: When he went on, he saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John, in a boat with their father Zebedee, preparing their nets. He called them.

ref: God blesses those people who depend only on him. They belong to the kingdom of heaven!
text: «Mimbirenyɩntazannɔ m mɩŋŋazerlezannɔ m: Ŋ hɔ m Woso cirbəə bɩ m.

translated: If you love me, don't forget this: Don't forget to come here tomorrow, please, I will be waiting for you.

text: «Durnya yɛ n'awɔɔ m. Bɩ, kʊ yɛ nyɩntabaa bɔ, n y'a bam lɔ, k'a a ya, a nyɩntabaa ka ʊ? A zibəə ba ʊ dɔ y, a lo n nawʊm garga ra, gʊɔɔ nɩ tʊntɔm la.»
translated: The world is like a woman. If you treat a woman well, she will stay with you, but if you don't, will the woman stay? A wise person knows this, so he takes good care of his wife, and they live in peace.

ref: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
text: Sɩra mɔɔ n'a hɩrɛ ɩbɩɩ m: Ɩbɩɩ bɩ bɔm b'ʊ k'ɩbɩɩ n ɩ zɩm bɩ ka haay y, bɩ tanka deem taan… bɩ gɔɔtarɛ y.» Jaandarɛ mim
translated: The child said to his mother: "We will go and when we go and see what is there, we will come back, we will not stay long... we promise you." The mother agreed.

translated: If you want to sleep, sleep peacefully: God will protect you, and you will wake up healthy.

ref: Instead, comb your hair and wash your face.

text: kʊ gʊɔɔ b'a dɔ, ŋ ʊ, ɩ lɛ ɩ kʊsɩ y. Bɩ, k'ɩ Zɩ k'a nɩ lɛɛ k'a nyaakʊm da ʊ bɩ n a dɔ a deem. B'a y'ɩ ganwʊrɛ karɛ ɩ ʊ.» Arzaka k'a nɩ arzana ʊ (Likki
translated: If you love someone, you must always help them. Also, when they are hungry, you should give them food to eat. You should always do good for them.

text: K'a maam, a b'a heer kɔ a bɩr a hɩrɛ, a ʊ: Bɔ wɔɔ n'a bɩrɛ? Bɔ wɔɔ n'a mire? Bɔ wɔɔ n'a dure ʊ ma?
translated: When he came, he asked her whether she was well, whether she was strong, whether she was healthy: How is your strength? How is your body? How is your health now?

translated: If you want to be strong: you must eat well, you must sleep well, you must work hard, and God will help you to succeed! So why are you not listening to my advice?

ref: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
text: Bɩ, kʊ Woso ɩ huu dum pooyaa bur ma ncɩnaaʊ, bɩ ta an a ʊ her kʊ sɛ n b'a bɩ booti m, a bɩ huu dure awɔɔ ma an lɛ da brɔɔ m na? Sɩrakarɛ poore zannɔ!
translated: Well, if Woso had not brought the medicine for me yesterday, I would not have been able to get up today, and I would have been in pain all day, right? Thank you very much!

translated: If you go there, tell me. If you see him, tell me. If you go to the market, buy something for me.

ref: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, “We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.”
text: Dʊdɔkarɛ hinni ʊ, gʊɔɔ gʊta y'a hɩrɛ: ‹Zuuba, Zuuba, ɩbɩɩ tɔ minto, wɔɔ Woso lɛ si ʊ so ra. Ɩbɩɩ tɔ ma wɔɔ la zinəro ra. Wɔɔ hoserlo ba gʊta ɩbɩɩ tɔ minto.›

translated: If someone does something to you, say: "Don't do that again. If you do it again, I will not forgive you!" If they do it again, (Likki)

translated: When I was young, I used to go to the river to fetch firewood with my friends. Jesus said we should love our friends as ourselves, and help those who are in need.

translated: When the wise man arrived at his house, he said to him, "Wise man, people say you know everything, so tell us what this is."

text: Yeezuu n a gaa zamaa bɩ jɩr ʊ, an bɔ m toore ma, an a nyʊkʊnnyɩnɔ dundu tikki bɩ tʊr ʊ, an lihi da, a nyʊkʊr ma, an a nɔ a nɛɛm ma,
translated: Yesterday I went to the farm with him, and we worked together, and when we finished, we returned home, and after that, I ate, and then I went to sleep.

ref: Jesus warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and of Herod.”
text: Yeezuu lɛ ka ŋ ʊ, a ʊ: «K'a dundo a zi, k'a ba laatʊ farizɛɛnrɔ nyʊnyɔɔ bɩ ma, kan Hɩrɔɔdɩ hɔ bɩ kɩ ma sɔ.»
translated: That same hour, some Pharisees came to him and said, "Leave this place and go somewhere else. Herod wants to kill you."
